agent_wizard.title: New Agent
agent_wizard.basics_help: Give the Agent a name you will recognise in conversations.
agent_wizard.name: Name
agent_wizard.runtime_help: Ramflux only carries messages and approvals; the Agent runs in a runtime.
agent_wizard.bind_later_help: After creation the Agent is not running. It can join conversations first.
agent_wizard.capabilities_help: Nothing is allowed until you turn it on. Risky actions still ask you each time.
agent_wizard.conversations_help: Choose which conversations may invite this Agent. Every invitation still asks you.
agent_wizard.nothing_unbound: Bind a runtime to choose what the Agent may do. Without one it can do nothing.
agent_wizard.review_help: Next you write down the Agent's recovery phrase once. You keep custody of it; the Agent never sees it.

agent.custody.unknown: Open and unlock your own account first. The daemon lists no account of yours that can custody an AI participant.
agent.custody.locked: Your account is locked. Unlock it first: only an unlocked account can custody an AI participant.
agent.custody.not_person: Only a person's account can custody an AI participant. Open your own account.
agent.custody.not_connected: Your account is not connected to its node yet. Wait until it is connected, then try again.
agent.settings.intro: AI participants are accounts you custody. Each one runs under the agent host from a one-time credentials bundle you export here. This app never unlocks them.
agent.settings.empty: You have no AI participant yet. Create one to let an AI take part in your conversations.
agent.row.custodian_unknown: Custodian: not reported by the daemon
agent.row.not_unlocked: Not unlocked here. The agent host starts it from the exported credentials.
agent.row.label: AI participant %{name}
agent.export.title: Export credentials of %{name}
agent.export.once: The daemon writes one file that only you can read (mode 0600) and never replaces a file that exists. The credentials can be exported once. The file holds the data passphrase and the account id, no recovery phrase and no master key, and this app never sees it.
agent.export.done_next: Only you can read the file, and it cannot be exported again. Start the agent host with --provisioning-bundle and this path; it imports the file and deletes it.
agent.export.refused.no_location: Choose a full path for the file, for example in your home folder.
agent.export.refused.not_owner_session: The daemon does not accept this from this session. Use your own unlocked account on this daemon.
agent.export.refused.owner_locked: Your account is locked. Unlock it, then export the credentials.
agent.export.refused.not_custodian: Only the custodian of this AI participant can export its credentials, and your account is not its custodian.
agent.export.refused.not_connected: Your account or the AI participant is not connected to its node yet. Wait until it is connected, then try again.
agent.export.refused.file_exists: A file already exists there, and the daemon never replaces one. Choose another location. Nothing was written.
agent.export.refused.location_denied: The daemon cannot write there. Choose a folder you can write to. Nothing was written.
agent.export.refused.location_missing: That folder does not exist. Choose an existing folder. Nothing was written.
agent.export.refused.credentials_gone: The credentials were exported already, or the vault no longer holds them. They can be exported once, and this AI participant cannot export them again.
agent.export.refused.vault_missing: The credentials were not exported: this device's key vault is not set up. Set it up first. They can be exported once.
agent.export.refused.vault_init_pending: The credentials were not exported: setting up this device's key vault was not finished. Finish it on this device (rf vault init), then export again.
agent.export.refused.vault_import_pendin: The credentials were not exported: importing the provisioned keys into this device's key vault was not finished. Retry the provisioning import, then export again.
agent.export.refused.vault_corrupt: The credentials were not exported: this device's key vault is damaged or failed its checks. Nothing was written.
agent.export.refused.vault_permission: The credentials were not exported: this device's key vault cannot be used because its files are not safe to use or access was denied. Nothing was written.
agent.export.refused.vault_locked: The credentials were not exported: this device's key vault is locked, or the unlock was cancelled or took too long. Unlock it and export again.
agent.export.refused.vault_busy: The credentials were not exported: this device's key vault is busy right now. Wait a moment and export again.
agent.export.refused.vault_primary_unava: The credentials were not exported: this device's key vault holds no primary key for this account.
agent.export.refused.timeout: The daemon did not answer in time. The credentials may have been written: check the location before you try again.
agent.export.refused.transport: The connection to the daemon broke. The credentials may have been written: check the location before you try again.
agent.export.refused.other: The daemon refused to export the credentials. Nothing was shown or changed here.
agent.entry.not_unlocked: AI participant. It is started by the agent host and cannot be unlocked here.

ceremony.title: Create account with a recovery phrase
ceremony.entry.help: Accounts are protected by 24 words that only you hold. No one can reset them for you.
ceremony.name.label: Account name
ceremony.name.node: This account will connect to the node %{node}.
ceremony.name.no_node: Add and confirm a node first: an account needs a node to connect to.
ceremony.name.help: The account is created on this device, then it connects to the node.
ceremony.ready.title: Get ready to write down 24 words
ceremony.ready.warning: Have pen and paper ready and write the words down offline, in order, with their numbers. Stop screen sharing and recording first and make sure nobody can see your screen: this app cannot block screenshots. The words appear once and cannot be shown again.
ceremony.show.title: Your recovery phrase
ceremony.show.warning: Write these 24 words down offline, in order. Never share them. Anyone who has these words owns your account.
ceremony.show.covered: The words are hidden because the window lost focus.
ceremony.show.no_copy: There is no copy button on purpose. The words stay on this screen only until you continue.
ceremony.show.missing: The words are no longer available. Cancel and start over to get a new phrase.
ceremony.cancel_question: Cancel this setup? The recovery phrase is erased and no account is created.
ceremony.passphrase.title: Set the account code for this device
ceremony.passphrase.help: You type this six-digit code to unlock the account on this device. It is not the recovery phrase and cannot recover it. If you forget it, you'll need your 24 words to restore this account.
ceremony.passphrase.label: Six-digit account code
ceremony.code.trivial: Choose a code that is not all one digit or a straight run such as 123456.
ceremony.confirm.title: Type three words back
ceremony.confirm.once: You have one attempt. If a word is wrong, the setup ends and no account is created.
ceremony.confirm.placeholder: The word, or its first four letters
ceremony.confirm.unknown: This is not one of the recovery words.
ceremony.done.title: Account created on this device
ceremony.done.text: %{name} was created on this device and is unlocked. It is connecting to %{node}: you can send and receive messages as soon as it is connected, and this screen updates by itself. If it does not connect, check that the node is reachable. Keep your 24 words safe: without another device, they are the only way to restore this account.
ceremony.done.live_text: %{name} was created on this device and is unlocked. Keep your 24 words safe: without another device, they are the only way to restore this account.
ceremony.ended.cancelled: Setup cancelled. The recovery phrase was erased and no account was created.
ceremony.ended.expired: This setup expired after 5 minutes. The recovery phrase was erased and no account was created.
ceremony.ended.mismatch: The words did not match. The setup ended and no account was created. Start over to get a new recovery phrase.
ceremony.ended.disabled: This daemon does not offer account creation with a recovery phrase.
ceremony.ended.vault: This device has no secure place to keep the account keys, so no account was created.
ceremony.ended.vault_missing: This device's key vault is not set up, so no account was created. Set it up, then try again.
ceremony.ended.vault_init_pending: Setting up this device's key vault was not finished, so no account was created. Finish it on this device (rf vault init), then try again.
ceremony.ended.vault_import_pending: Importing the provisioned keys into this device's key vault was not finished, so no account was created. Retry the provisioning import, then try again.
ceremony.ended.vault_corrupt: This device's key vault is damaged or failed its checks, so no account was created. Nothing was changed.
ceremony.ended.vault_permission: This device's key vault cannot be used: its files are not safe to use or access was denied. No account was created.
ceremony.ended.vault_locked: This device's key vault is locked, or the unlock was cancelled or took too long. Unlock it and try again. No account was created.
ceremony.ended.vault_busy: This device's key vault is busy right now. Wait a moment and try again. No account was created.
ceremony.ended.vault_primary_unavailable: This device's key vault holds no primary key for this account, so no account was created.
ceremony.ended.invalid: The setup could not continue because a step was refused. No account was created.
